"""
ElementSets from MeshConnectivity
VertexOneRing, Faces, NeighborVerticesInFace from Neighborhoods(M)
M : FaceMesh
x_i ∈ ℝ^3  
V, E, F = ElementSets( M )

			               min(d_j+‖x_j - x_i‖, d_k+‖x_k - x_i‖) otherwise 
where i,j,k ∈ V, d_i ∈ ℝ,
X = [x_j-x_i x_k-x_i],
t = [d_j d_k]ᵀ,
Q = (XᵀX)⁻¹,
`1` = [1 ; 1],
p = (`1`ᵀQt + sqrt((`1`ᵀQt)² - `1`ᵀQ`1` ⋅ (tᵀQt - 1)))/ (`1`ᵀQ`1`),
n = XQ(t- p ⋅`1`),
s = QXᵀn

"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M, x):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = x.shape[0]
        assert x.shape == (dim_0, 3, )

        self.M = M
        self.x = x
        _Neighborhoods = self.Neighborhoods(M)
        self.VertexOneRing = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing
        self.VertexOneRing_0 = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing_0
        self.Faces = _Neighborhoods.Faces
        self.Faces_0 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_0
        self.Faces_1 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_1
        self.NeighborVerticesInFace = _Neighborhoods.NeighborVerticesInFace
        pass

    def UpdateStep(self, i, j, k, d):
        d = np.asarray(d, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_1 = d.shape[0]
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert np.ndim(k) == 0
        assert d.shape == (dim_1,)
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V
        assert k in self.V

        # X = [x_j-x_i x_k-x_i]
        X_0 = np.hstack(((self.x[j] - self.x[i]).reshape(3, 1), (self.x[k] - self.x[i]).reshape(3, 1)))
        X = X_0

        # t = [d_j d_k]ᵀ
        t_0 = np.zeros((1, 2))
        t_0[0] = [d[j], d[k]]
        t = t_0.T

        # Q = (XᵀX)⁻¹
        Q = np.linalg.inv((X.T @ X))

        # `1` = [1 ; 1]
        num1_0 = np.zeros((2, 1))
        num1_0[0] = [1]
        num1_0[1] = [1]
        num1 = num1_0

        # p = (`1`ᵀQt + sqrt((`1`ᵀQt)² - `1`ᵀQ`1` ⋅ (tᵀQt - 1)))/ (`1`ᵀQ`1`)
        p = (((num1.T @ Q @ t).item() + np.sqrt(np.power(np.asarray(((num1.T @ Q @ t).item()), dtype=np.float64), 2) - (num1.T @ Q @ num1).item() * ((t.T @ Q @ t).item() - 1)))) / (((num1.T @ Q @ num1).item()))

        # n = XQ(t- p ⋅`1`)
        n = X @ Q @ (t - p * num1)

        # s = QXᵀn
        s = Q @ X.T @ n
        if (s[1-1, 1-1] < 0) and (s[2-1, 1-1] < 0):
            UpdateStep_ret = p
        else:
            UpdateStep_ret = min(d[j] + np.linalg.norm(self.x[j] - self.x[i], 2), d[k] + np.linalg.norm(self.x[k] - self.x[i], 2))
        return UpdateStep_ret

    def GetNextLevel(self, U):
        U = np.fromiter((frozenset(x) for x in U), dtype=object, count=len(U))
        dim_2 = U.shape[0]
        # s = ∪_i U_i
        union_0 = frozenset()
        for i in range(1, len(U)+1):
            union_0 = frozenset.union(union_0, U[i-1])
        s = union_0

        # v = VertexOneRing(s)
        v = self.VertexOneRing_0(s)
        return v - s

    def GetRangeLevel(self, U, a, b):
        U = np.fromiter((frozenset(x) for x in U), dtype=object, count=len(U))
        dim_3 = U.shape[0]
        assert np.ndim(a) == 0
        assert np.ndim(b) == 0

        union_1 = frozenset()
        for i in range(a, b+1):
            union_1 = frozenset.union(union_1, U[i])
        return union_1

    def GetLevelSequence(self, U):
        U = np.fromiter((frozenset(x) for x in U), dtype=object, count=len(U))
        dim_4 = U.shape[0]
        # next = GetNextLevel(U)
        next = self.GetNextLevel(U)
        if len(next) != 0:
            seq = list(U)
            seq.append(next)
            GetLevelSequence_ret = seq
        else:
            GetLevelSequence_ret = U
        return GetLevelSequence_ret
    class Neighborhoods:
        def __init__(self, M):
            rhs = M.ElementSets()
            self.V = rhs[0]
            self.E = rhs[1]
            self.F = rhs[2]
            dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
            dime_0 = M.n_edges()
            dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
            self.M = M
            _FundamentalMeshAccessors = self.FundamentalMeshAccessors(M)
            self.Vertices = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices
            self.Vertices_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_0
            self.Vertices_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_1
            self.Vertices_2 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_2
            self.Vertices_3 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_3
            self.Edges = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges
            self.Edges_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges_0
            self.Edges_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges_1
            self.Faces = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces
            self.Faces_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces_0
            self.Faces_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces_1
            rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
            self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
            self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
            rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
            self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
            self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
            # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
            self.B0T = self.B0.T
            # `B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
            self.B1T = self.B1.T
        def VertexOneRing(self, v):
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))) - {v}
        def VertexOneRing_0(self, v):
            v = frozenset(v)
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator(v, self.M.n_vertices()))) - v
        def EdgeIndex(self, i, j):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            # eset = Edges(i) ∩ Edges(j)
            eset = frozenset.intersection(self.Edges_0(i), self.Edges_0(j))
            return sorted(eset)[1-1]
        def NeighborVerticesInFace(self, f, v):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            assert f in self.F
            # es = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂¹` IndicatorVector({f})))
            es = nonzeros(self.dee1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))
            # nes = { s for s ∈ es if `∂⁰`_v,s != 0 }
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1 = set()
            set_range = es
            for s in set_range:
                if(self.dee0.tocsr()[v, s] != 0):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1.add(s)
            nes = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1
            # eset1 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2 = set()
            set_range_1 = nes
            for e in set_range_1:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2.add(e)
            eset1 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2
            # vset1 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset1))) - {v}
            vset1 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset1, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
            # eset2 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = 1 }
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4 = set()
            set_range_2 = nes
            for e in set_range_2:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == 1):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4.add(e)
            eset2 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4
            # vset2 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset2))) - {v}
            vset2 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset2, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
            return [sorted(vset1)[1-1],sorted(vset2)[1-1]]
        def NextVerticeInFace(self, f, v):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            assert f in self.F
            # eset = { e for e ∈ Edges(f) if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
            NextVerticeInFaceset_0 = set()
